summary.text: Kevin Abel is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia State Senate, District 14, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican Michael Dvorscak in a race with no incumbent.
Abel co-founded the technology consulting company Abel Solutions in 1994 and, according to his Ballotpedia survey, has served on the Georgia Department of Transportation Board.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Abel moved to the United States from South Africa at age 14 and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at Austin in 1987.
He and his wife, Cindy, started Abel Solutions, a technology consulting company, in 1994.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Abel said he moved to North Fulton in 1990, has served on non-profit boards and led a task force to combat antisemitism, and has worked in the refugee resettlement arena and on Georgia's Department of Transportation Board.
Abel ran in the 2018 Democratic primary for Georgia's 6th Congressional District, advancing to a runoff that he lost to Lucy McBath.
In 2026 he defeated Nathalie Kanani, 50.9% to 49.1%, in the June 16 Democratic primary runoff for State Senate District 14.
In the survey, Abel listed affordability, healthcare and leadership as his key messages and said he would push to expand Medicaid in Georgia and to end the state's abortion ban.
